title: Sessions
emptyDescription: Sessions will appear here once you start chatting.

detail.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete all messages in this session.
detail.resetDescription: This will clear all messages but keep the session.
detail.compactDescription: Summarize the older portion of the conversation with the agent's LLM, store the summary on the session, and truncate the history to the last 4 messages. Frees the context window while preserving what was discussed — same flow Claude Code's /compact uses. If summarization fails, falls back to a plain truncate (no summary).
detail.compactingHint: The agent's LLM is summarizing the older messages. This can take 20-30 seconds — don't close this window.

toast.compactTooShort: Session is too short to compact
